# guard/ — deterministic crisis-referral filter

**No referral the user sees was ever generated by the model.** Every sentence the model produced
that contains something referral-shaped — a number, a URL, an organisation name, a bracket
placeholder — is removed whole, and the only contact information a user can see is the block in
`resources.json`, appended by code.

Correct referrals are removed too. "Call or text 988 any time." is dropped like any other, because
the invariant is about *provenance*, not accuracy: the model is never the source of a number a
distressed person might dial.

## Why not an LLM checker

In the research self-play data an LLM judge rated dialogues containing fabricated hotline numbers
~3.75/5 for appropriateness — it caught none of them. Hence pure regex, zero latency, no network.

## How it is wired

`factory.make_generator()` wraps whatever generator the env selected in `SafeGenerator`, so echo,
local Ollama, OpenRouter, the steering service *and* `SteeredRemoteGenerator`'s fall-back-to-Ollama
path are all filtered. `therapy.async_turn` appends the footer to the **outward** reply only.

| consumer | sees |
|---|---|
| UI / `/chat` reply | clean reply + footer (when flagged) |
| `session.history` → next-turn model context | clean reply, canonical sentence substituted, **no footer** |
| `session.transcript` → Tier B extraction / graph | same clean reply, **no footer** |
| `guard/logs/guard_log.jsonl` | raw reply + removals (research record) |

The footer is deliberately kept out of history: `serve_steer.py` generates with
`no_repeat_ngram_size=3` over the whole sequence, so footer n-grams in an assistant turn would *ban*
the model from producing that phrasing itself — and in practice it starts imitating and mutating the
format instead.

## Toggle

```bash
REFERRAL_GUARD=1   # default — guard on
REFERRAL_GUARD=0   # off; byte-identical to pre-guard behaviour (research mode)
```

## resources.json — verified for Japan (2026-07-30)

`"verified": true` ships in this repo, so the footer displays these four entries, in order:

| region | entry | source |
|---|---|---|
| GLOBAL | Find A Helpline — https://findahelpline.com | `findahelpline.com` |
| GLOBAL | Befrienders Worldwide — https://befrienders.org | `befrienders.org` |
| JP | #いのちSOS (NPO LIFELINK) — 0120-061-338, toll-free, 24h/365d | MHLW `mhlw.go.jp` |
| JP | よりそいホットライン — 0120-279-338, toll-free, 24h, foreign-language support | MHLW `mhlw.go.jp` |

**Deploying to another locale, or after time has passed:** re-check every entry against its
`source_url`, update `checked_on`, and replace the region-specific ones. Do not populate numbers from
memory — shipping an unverified crisis number is the exact failure this guard prevents. Setting
`"verified": false` is always the safe fallback: the footer reverts to the number-free `generic_line`
and **no number is displayed at all**.

`guard/tests/test_sanitize.py::test_resources_honour_the_verification_contract` enforces this both
ways — while `verified` is false the footer must be digit-free, and while it is true every displayed
entry must carry a `source_url` and a valid `checked_on` date. You cannot flip the flag without
naming a source and a date for each entry.

## Relationship to the steering service's own guard

`steering/serve_steer.py` has a separate crisis guard covering the **steered path only** (it drops
the vector on crisis turns and appends its own line). This guard sits one level out, at the
generator boundary, and covers every path. It also strips the service's appended line — listed under
`upstream_lines` in `resources.json` — so exactly one footer reaches the user. Detection patterns are
duplicated rather than imported, because `guard/` and `steering/` are independent add-ons;
`tests/test_sanitize.py` pins them as a strict superset of `steer_runtime.PHONE_RE`.

## Files

- `sanitize.py` — pure functions: `sanitize()`, `load_config()`, `footer_text()`, `contains_crisis()`.
- `safe_generator.py` — `SafeGenerator(inner)`, the `Generator`-protocol wrapper.
- `resources.json` — the only source of displayed referral text.
- `tests/test_sanitize.py` — 32 tests; offline, no GPU. Picked up by the root `pyproject.toml`.
- `logs/guard_log.jsonl` — gitignored; one JSON line per removal or crisis turn.

The dated implementation record (`NOTES.md`) and the original spec (`docs/PLAN_referral_guard.md`)
live in the `graph-steering-chatbot-sd` scratch copy, along with `SD_DEPLOY_NOTES.md` — the record of
why Self-disclosure is prompted rather than steered. They were deliberately left out of the deploy
repo; look there if you need the reasoning behind a decision this README only states.
